_comment: Canonical Turbo package index. This is a STATIC, git-versioned, curated registry — there is no dynamic registry service and no auth. Publishing a package is a pull request that appends one object to `packages` below. Each object: { "name" (unique, matches the turbo_modules dir name), "repo" ("owner/name" on GitHub), "description", "categories" (array of lowercase tags), optional "min_turbo_version" (semver the package needs), optional "homepage" (URL). The array is intentionally empty: no first-party Turbo package is cleanly installable as a registry entry yet, and listing a package before it resolves as a real turbo_modules dependency would be dishonest. See docs/packages.md for the full schema and publishing flow.
